All 4 silhouettes COMPLETE, each occupies only 60% of its cell height, with a fully transparent 100-pixel border all around and between sprites. ONE GAME ASSET CUTOUT on EMPTY TRANSPARENT ALPHA, RGBA PNG. Reference2 shows IDENTITY ONLY: preserve this building's architecture, not its old rendering or blue night cast. It must look natural beside the buildings in reference1. Fixed 2:1 isometric camera and SCREEN UPPER RIGHT SUN in every view; right-facing planes warm, left-facing planes cooler. Exactly four true rigid quarter turns of the SAME physical object on a square 2x2 sheet: NE front+right, SE right+back, SW back+left, NW left+front. Same roof, windows, equipment and physical scale throughout; reconstruct hidden sides, never mirror a front. Centre each complete sprite within its own cell with20% blank margins on every side. Rear views need genuinely reconstructed rear facades, not four front variations. Do not copy reference camera four times.  Subject library ID variation:ref-building-mausoleum-719fd618-plain:1. Rebuild this exact architecture in the shared Maple Bean art theme. Keep building height, wing/deck/garage position and roof shape. True opposite rear facades, no duplicated entrance/porch on all four sides. If identity is a rear view, retain it as one real rear face and reconstruct a sensible front; never clone the rear facade four times. Keep full roof/chimney and steps well clear of all canvas edges; small sprites with generous transparent space, no floors or yards.
